purpose: Force-based mechanistic basis for I-band extension; supplies the recruitment order as a DERIVED result rather than prose.

physics.topology: The four I-band elastic regions are in mechanical SERIES between the Z-disc and the thick-filament tip, therefore they bear a COMMON force. One scalar force fixes the entire partition.
physics.T_rationale: 300 K is the temperature of the pnas.95.14.8052 experiments, i.e. the temperature at which the sourced persistence lengths were measured.

laws.ewlc: z/Lc = y(f) + f/K0  -- entropic + enthalpic; no contour ceiling

no_fitted_parameters: Every A, K0 and Lc above is taken from a cited source or from the spec. None was adjusted to improve agreement with structural_states.json. The agreement reported below is therefore independent corroboration, not a fit.

source_validation.quantity: force at the paper's stated 60% validity boundary
poly-Ig fractional extension at the 35 pN fit limit

continuity.interpretation: ratio ~10 means the apparent step is finite sampling of a steep but continuous limb; ratio ~1 would mean a true jump

derived_recruitment.method: Rank each region by the force at which it first reaches 25% of its own contour length, using only the sourced force-extension laws. Independent of structural_states.json.
derived_recruitment.qualitative_claim_under_test: Compliance should migrate from the poly-Ig tandems at short SL to PEVK at long SL (the spec's prose ordering: Ig straightening -> N2A -> PEVK).

migration_test.verdict: PASS -- the prose ordering is reproduced by the sourced physics

isoform_scope.spec_isoform: Human canonical titin, UniProt Q8WZ42 — PEVK 1807 aa, contour length 542.1 nm as computed from this spec's own residue span.
isoform_scope.chain_parameter_isoform: Rat psoas skeletal titin (10.1073/pnas.95.14.8052). The persistence lengths and the PEVK stretch modulus are measured on that isoform, not on Q8WZ42.
isoform_scope.why_this_is_acceptable_for_A_and_K0: Persistence length A and stretch modulus K0 are per-unit-length MATERIAL properties of the polymer, so they transfer across isoforms. Contour lengths are NOT transferred: every Lc in chain_parameters is computed from this spec's own domain counts and residue spans, never adopted from the source isoform.
isoform_scope.consequence_for_relative_extension: None. Fractional extension z/Lc is a function of force alone, so it is isoform-independent: at 10 pN the model gives 56.9% for PEVK Lc = 542.1, 300.0 and 240.0 nm alike (spread 0.0). Relative extension claims therefore carry over from the source isoform without adjustment.
isoform_scope.consequence_for_absolute_force: Absolute force IS isoform-sensitive, because a shorter contour reaches the same absolute extension at a higher force. At SL 3.0 um the predicted force rises 10.4 -> 14.6 -> 25.8 -> 67.2 pN as PEVK contour falls 542.1 -> 450 -> 350 -> 240 nm. Forces predicted here for the long-PEVK canonical isoform are therefore LOWER BOUNDS relative to a short-PEVK psoas fibre at equal sarcomere length, and any agreement in absolute pN across isoforms cannot be claimed as validation.
isoform_scope.evidence_class: MODELED (series force balance over MEASURED chain parameters)

cross_isoform_plausibility_check.source_statement: At 2.9-3.0 um sarcomere length, force per titin is near 10 pN with PEVK extension about 50%.
cross_isoform_plausibility_check.why_the_prediction_is_not_a_fit: The model consumes no force datum and no extension datum. Each I-band total follows from sarcomere geometry alone (SL, Z-disc width, thick-filament half-length), and the force is then the single scalar that makes the four series regions sum to that total. Both columns are outputs.
cross_isoform_plausibility_check.why_not_validation: The agreement has two halves and only one is informative. The PEVK-percent half is isoform-independent (z/Lc depends on force alone), so matching ~50% is just a restatement of the source's own force-extension relation — already covered by source_validation. The absolute-force half IS isoform-sensitive, and this spec's isoform differs from the source's, so a pN match across the two cannot be read as confirming this spec's numbers.
cross_isoform_plausibility_check.what_makes_it_non_circular: No parameter was fitted to the quantity being checked: the chain parameters come from force-extension experiments, while the I-band totals come from independently sourced sarcomere geometry. The check can therefore fail — it is not guaranteed by construction — which is what makes it worth recording even though it is not validation.
